text:
maya: Quick check 10am TOM for vendor preflight. Scope: lock embargo holds and marketplace prelist gating for H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi. Can each owner confirm constraints?

todd: Marketplace: we can host hidden prelists (access=partner,si) but will only flip to public when `driver_ok` AND `checksum_signed` are present. Need canonical SKU IDs by EOD.

leena: Infra: vendors still giving ranges. We'll publish nightly canaries at `canary/<vendor>/<date>` and attach `ci_badge=pass|fail`. GA window TBD.

zhou: SI lead: require two dry-run passes separated by 48h. Gaudi lab capacity tight Apr 7-11. Ask partners to reserve slots asap.

maya: Marketing: prefer Tues/Weds for press lifts. Also need 72h minimum for quote approvals unless vendor waives to 48h.

todd: I'll add `prelist_visibility=hidden` and `publish_triggers=[driver_ok,checksum_signed,quote_ok]` to SKU metadata.

leena: Quick ops snippet for fallback routing we'll test in staging: `fallback_map = {H200: [H100, B200]}; grace_days=14`. This auto-shifts only if canary health drops.

zhou: SI checklist highlights: basic inference, batch stability, kv-cache continuity, restart/restore. Will post matrix and signup link.

maya: Action items: Todd -> prelist schema + SKU fields; Leena -> canary URLs + CI badges; Zhou -> SI signup + smoke matrix; Maya -> embargo doc + vendor opt-in.

partner-bot: Invite created: "HW preflight 10am" https://calendar.redwood.com/event/1759999991-preflight :white_check_mark:

todd: One edge-case: vendors may request logo/quote redlines. We'll include `quote_review_window` per vendor in the opt-in doc.

leena: Also adding `artifact_signed_checksum` as a hard gate for public flips to avoid bad images.

zhou: Reserving Gaudi slots Apr 8 & Apr 10 for extended SI runs. Please claim quickly.

maya: If any vendor slips beyond fallback window, we'll publish a partner note offering migration assistance and prioritized runtime fixes. Drafting now.

todd: I'll prepare a minimal pricing field for Dedicated SKUs (`min_commit_days=30`) to include in prelist metadata.

maya: Thanks team. If dates change, bump this thread and we'll adjust windows. :thumbsup:
